scope.description: Scoped original truth for RoleInfo 574 five feature buttons, P1/P2 transforms, SetMenu 371, Help 444, entry gates and the negative absence of a universal map/battle feature-host chrome. External page roots remain owned by their page manifests.

provenance.locator: characters 574 export.RoleInfo, 371 export.setmenu.SetMenu, 444 export.Help; 549/555/561/567/573 HUD buttons; 337/342/347/351/355/359/362/370 settings buttons; 436/440/441 help buttons; FFDec 26 selective SVG/PNG/button export.
constructor/setPos/added/removed/showBackPack/setClick/studySkill/fbClick/cwClick; P2 child scale correction and entry gates.
refreshRoleInfo creates one 574 per player, P2 x=920 and parent scaleX=-1.
frame 1/2 selection, actionHelp/achivePet/btnback listeners and removal.
character 574 first-frame PlaceObject list; 27 children; five scoped buttons at depths 52/55/58/61/64.
character 371 first-frame PlaceObject list; background, eight buttons and speed MovieClip.
character 444 two-frame PlaceObject list; depth-1 432->443 swap and three retained buttons.
